clips.title: The story
paras: At Northshire Abbey, Glyphic Letter calls promising novitiates to arcane study. After early service to the garrison, they are summoned upstairs to Khelden Bremen, the resident mage trainer.

Khelden Bremen seals the Glyphic Letter with his personal insignia. Apprentice spellcasters receive it after proving their discipline in Northshire Valley. The summons calls them away from basic field duties and into dedicated magical instruction within the abbey. Bremen tests each student's resolve before they take up the arcane, with its dangerous forces, unyielding scrutiny, and burdens.
